audit.whatIsWrong: packet defect: "level chart contradicts data: Vayne wins 56.26% but the chart gives Ambessa 5/7 stages vs 1". Four rows also contradict their own why-text: row 0 reads Ambessa while whys[0] says level 1 is even; row 3 reads Skill while whys[3] says her mobility zones you off CS; row 5 reads Skill while whys[5] says her first-item spike still out-trades you; row 6 reads Ambessa while whys[6], spikes[3] and late all say Vayne outscales with 2+ items.
audit.why: 56.26% over 967 games is a Vayne-favoured matchup that is won late, not early. The packet chart — Skill / Ambessa x5 / Vayne — matches every line of prose on the page and gives Vayne the row her win rate comes from.
audit.corrected: phases[0].side and win[0] = Skill (5/10); phases[3].side and win[3] = Ambessa (3/10); phases[5].side and win[5] = Ambessa (3/10); phases[6].side and win[6] = Vayne (8/10). Rows 1, 2 and 4 already read Ambessa and are left alone.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every spike and cooldown line pointed at "Repeating Dashes", an ability that does not exist, and gave no numbers. sequencingCues was 1 for the whole matchup.
audit.why: The real timers are Public Execution 130/115/100s, Lacerate 13/12/11/10/9s, Cunning Sweep 14/13/12/11/10s and Repudiation 18/17/16/15/14s. Against a 130s ultimate the whole lane is 'is her R up', and that is the number the page never printed.
audit.corrected: Public Execution 130s at rank 1 named as the tracked cooldown in winCon, dosFull[0], breakdown.cooldowns and report[5]; Lacerate 13s at rank 1 used for the step-up window in phases[3], phases[5] and dontsFull[1].

audit.whatIsWrong: "Repeating Dashes" is a fabricated ability name repeated across roughly fifteen fields. spikes[0].text also mislabels the kit: it calls Sundering Slam the Q and Cunning Sweep the W. Cunning Sweep IS the Q, Sundering Slam is the transformed second cast of that same Q, and W is Repudiation. Three real interactions were absent: Repudiation shields her through your burst window, Drakehound's Step is an auto-reset that tells you the combo is starting, and Public Execution carries healing so Grievous Wounds timing matters.
audit.why: A player tracking a non-existent cooldown tracks nothing. Naming Repudiation matters because it is a braced shield that gets bigger if you hit it — dumping Silver Bolts into the brace is exactly the mistake.
audit.corrected: Cunning Sweep (Q) transforms into Sundering Slam; Repudiation (W) shields and punishes damage taken during the brace; Lacerate (E) is the slow-and-dash; Public Execution (R) is a 1250-range blink that suppresses, slams and stuns. Step back on the Drakehound's Step wind-up, not the cast.
